Class CustomerManagementController

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.controller.CustomerManagementController
public class CustomerManagementController extends Object
Controller for managing customer operations including registration, updates, membership management, and customer data display. Coordinates between the view and customer service layer.

      public void handleViewAllCustomers()
      Handles displaying all customers in the system. Catches and handles any exceptions during the loading process.

    • handleViewCustomerDetails

      public void handleViewCustomerDetails()
      Handles viewing detailed information for a specific customer. Prompts for customer ID and displays customer details if found.

    • handleRegisterCustomer

      public void handleRegisterCustomer()
      Handles registering a new customer with basic information. Prompts for customer name and senior citizen status.

    • handleRegisterWithMembership

      public void handleRegisterWithMembership()
      Handles registering a new customer with a membership card. Prompts for customer name, senior citizen status, card number, and expiry date.

    • handleUpdateCustomer

      public void handleUpdateCustomer()
      Handles updating an existing customer's information. Prompts for customer ID and allows updating name and senior citizen status.

    • handleRemoveCustomer

      public void handleRemoveCustomer()
      Handles removing a customer from the system. Prompts for customer ID and requires confirmation before removal.

    • handleAddMembershipCard

      public void handleAddMembershipCard()
      Handles adding a membership card to an existing customer. Prompts for customer ID, card number, and expiry date.
